name: Pavlodar

queries.query: Pavlodar Kazakhstan official cadastral map parcel GIS cadastral map Pavlodar official
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Pavlodar regional geoportal, its public GeoServer catalog, an official government announcement, and the state-system registry entry. The live GeoServer exposes an anonymous WFS cadastral layer.

queries.query: Павлодар кадастр земельный участок карта официальный геопортал
queries.result: Первая сторона подтверждает официальный Геопортал Павлодарской области и региональную геоинформационную систему для земельных отношений; публичный GeoServer WFS предоставляет слой gzk_features_moved с кадастровыми номерами и геометрией.

registryEvidence.custodian: Digital technology management of the Pavlodar region / regional geo-information portal (RGIS), with the Pavlodar regional land-relations authority as the land-administration custodian.
registryEvidence.basis: The official gov.kz announcement identifies the regional geoportal and its land-relations services. The official state information-system registry identifies the operational Geo-information portal of Pavlodar region and its regional government owner. The live first-party GeoServer WFS publishes the Pavlodar cadastral feature layer.

officialSources.observation: Official regional government announcement says the Pavlodar geo-information portal is launched for land-relations services.
officialSources.scope: Regional portal and land-service custodian evidence; not itself a parcel response.

officialSources.observation: Official state information-system registry lists the operational Geo-information portal of Pavlodar region, owned by the regional digital-technology administration, with spatial-data and land-service purposes.
First-party WFS capabilities identify provider УИИР Павлодарской области and publish gis_pavlodar:gzk_features_moved.
officialSources.scope: Live public service metadata and layer catalog.

service.nativeIdentity: cad_number (stable cadastral number); WFS feature id/objectid also observed but not retained as the canonical sample identity

requests.outcome: Official portal shell fetched; JavaScript bundle exposed the live GeoServer configuration.
Public WFS capabilities fetched; layer and provider identified.
Schema fetched: objectid integer, cad_number string, geom MultiPolygon, plus non-retained source fields.
Bounded anonymous response returned 3 full MultiPolygon features, totalFeatures=16; three safe geometries retained in pavlodar-sample.geojson.
Bounded city-area-style extent returned numberMatched=84694; this is a service extent/count observation, not a validated city boundary coverage count.
Tiny exact-point bounding query returned zero features; not interpreted as citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Pavlodar regional geoportal cadastral layer published by the regional public GeoServer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous WFS layer and parcel geometry verified near the WUP point; no independent city-boundary completeness audit performed.

remainingUncertainty: The public service is real and returns parcel geometry, but the citywide completeness of the layer, update cadence, and production adapter behavior remain unqualified. The exact WUP point fell in no returned parcel in the tiny query; this is only a point-level result.
